title: settings mode and grouping thresholds
rule: One mode per page: Instant Effect or Submission Effect (use submit when items interdepend). Item count: <7 no grouping; 7–15 group; >15 tab grouping.
pass_when: A settings page is one mode (instant or submission). Counts follow <7 / 7–15 / >15 tab grouping. Interdependent items use submission.
fail_when: Instant and submission mixed on one page; or counts grouped against those bands.
overview: A settings page is one mode; group items by Ant’s count thresholds.
apply_when: Structuring an Ant settings page with many interdependent items.
not_when: Short one-off forms that are not settings inventory pages.
agent_hint: Pick instant or submission mode once; group by <7, 7–15, or tabs >15.
description: Ant settings pages use one mode end to end: Instant Effect or Submission Effect, and submission when items interdepend. Item count drives grouping: under seven needs no grouping, seven to fifteen group together, and over fifteen use tab grouping. Apply when structuring a settings inventory page, not a short one-off form. Fail mixing instant and submission on one page, or grouping that ignores those count bands.
do_not_claim: A house number that replaces 7 / 15; Switch-immediate as this page-mode row.
